findings.message: The File Properties Object gives different minimum (128) and maximum (256) packet sizes; the specification makes them equal, and fixed-size packets are required (sections 3.2 and 8.2.13).
Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
